profile.name: GITEGO Faycal
profile.title: Computer Science Educator | IT Support | Software Developer
profile.tagline: Educator and IT professional who teaches software development, runs a school computer lab and builds practical web applications.

about.summary: Computer Science and Mathematics graduate (BEd Honours, University of Rwanda) now pursuing a Master's in Information Technology at UNILAK. Currently Software Development Teacher and ICT Lab Support at St. Charles de Jésus School, with hands-on experience installing, configuring and troubleshooting Windows computers, software, networks and peripherals, and a strong record of explaining technical issues clearly to non-technical users. Trained in full-stack development (Java, PHP, JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, Spring Boot, Python, Flask, MySQL, Git) and certified in ICDL, DSE Full-Stack Development and ALX Virtual Assistance. Passionate about teaching software development and helping learners build practical programming, web development, database and problem-solving skills.
competencies: Clear verbal and written communication (English and Kinyarwanda)
Incident logging, asset inventories and reporting in Excel
strengths: Strong combination of education, communication and technical expertise.
Patient, clear communicator with daily experience supporting users of all skill levels.
Organised and reliable: accurate records, follow-up and timely feedback to users.
Ability to communicate complex information clearly and practically.
Fast learner of new tools; comfortable working independently in Kigali and upcountry.
Team-oriented with a commitment to professional development.

experience.role: Software Development Teacher & ICT Lab Support
bullets: Deliver TVET Level 3 modules in Website Development, Basic Graphic Design (Photoshop, Illustrator), UI/UX Design, Version Control (Git/GitHub) and Project Requirements Analysis.
Set up and maintain the school computer lab for practical lessons: install and update Windows software, create user accounts, configure printers and projectors, and keep machines virus-free.
Act as first point of contact for students' and teachers' hardware, software and network problems; diagnose, fix or escalate to the school administration.
Log issues and follow up until each user is satisfied.
Produce all teaching materials, cheat-sheets and step-by-step guides used in class.
Guide practical programming activities and assess learners' technical skills.

experience.company: University of Rwanda – College of Education
bullets: Assisted the campus photographer in covering major university events (graduations, conferences, official visits), including setting up and operating cameras, lighting and audio equipment.
Supported live streaming of events: equipment connection, laptops, internet connectivity and troubleshooting during broadcasts.
Taught Mathematics and ICT to secondary-school learners during school attachment.
Planned and delivered lessons according to learners' needs and curriculum requirements.
Explained technical and mathematical concepts clearly using practical, easy-to-understand examples.
Supported learners and staff with everyday computer use during ICT practicals.
Supported learners with different levels of understanding through individual guidance and classroom activities.
